notes:
UI/UX 规范化与设置界面重构
1. 规范：引入全新《Lexicon UI/UX 工业设计规范》并写入 AI 核心准则。
2. 重构：彻底清理 Settings 设置界面的“盒中盒”嵌套结构，去除冗余边框与内边距。
3. 优化：统一 Toggle 交互热区大小与 Accordion 组件无缝贴合 (Flush) 视觉效果，对齐 Apple HIG 与 Fluent 2 设计语言。

notes_en:
UI/UX Standardization & Settings Interface Refactoring
1. Standard: Introduced the new "Lexicon UI/UX Design System" and embedded it into core AI directives.
2. Refactoring: Cleaned up the nested "Box-in-Box" antipattern in Settings, removing redundant borders and padding.
3. Optimization: Standardized Toggle interactive hitboxes and implemented perfectly flush Accordion visual effects, aligning with Apple HIG and Fluent 2 design language.
